verdicts.reason: Layer-1 account retaining Rs 2.29 lakh of tainted funds (~45% of disputed amount, well above the 25% threshold). Constrained payee count (2), device sharing with 17 accounts, and 35% pass-through ratio support the mule label; the lien only touches 7.7% of the account's balance, freezing only the victim's traced money.

Although the account is a registered merchant with a negligible tainted share (0.027%), it holds Rs 2.06 lakh of the victim's traced money (~41% of the disputed amount, exceeding the 25% threshold). The lien is minuscule relative to the Rs 7.66 crore balance, so it does not meaningfully freeze the merchant's own funds.
